title: zeroxpos~
description: `zeroxpos~` finds a specified zero-crossing point within a DSP block, outputting its position in samples and its direction (polarity) from the right outlet. Its creation argument selects the crossing: a positive value counts from the start of the block, while a negative value counts from the end; in mode 0 it searches only after a bang, whereas mode 1 searches continuously and outputs the stored result when banged.
